description: This file contains test functions for error handling helpers such as ExistingErrorOr and AnyError, using the testify/assert package for assertions.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrTT
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns the first non-nil error.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrTF
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr short circuits when the first argument is non-nil.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrFT
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns the error from the function when first argument is nil.

methods.name: TestExistingErrorOrFF
methods.description: Tests that ExistingErrorOr returns nil when both arguments are nil.

methods.name: TestAnyErrorPositive
methods.description: Tests that AnyError returns the existing error when present.

methods.name: TestAnyErrorNegative
methods.description: Tests that AnyError returns nil when no errors are provided.
